test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Identify the errors in the given sentence and choose the sentence that rectifies these errors. The boy you met on an train last night was quite impressed by you. He has expressed his wish to work under you.

options.text: The boy you met on train last night was quite impressed by you. He has expressed his wish to work under you.
Bay you met on the train last night was quite impressed by you. He has expressed his wish to work under you.
The boy you met on the train last night was quite impressed by you. He has expressed his wish to work under you.
An boy you met on the train last night was quite impressed by you. He has expressed his wish to work under you.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect article "**an**" before the term "**train**."
 
• The correct article to use is "**the**" to refer to a specific train mentioned.
 
• The phrase should be "**on the train**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The boy you met on the train last night was quite impressed by you. He has expressed his wish to work under you."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Bay you met on the train last night"** – This part of the sentence is incorrect because "Bay" should be "boy".
 
• **Option 3: "The boy you met on the tram last night"** – This part of the sentence is incorrect because "tram" should be "train".
 
• **Option 4: "An boy you met on the train last night"** – This part of the sentence is incorrect because "An" should be "The".

``
